description: §14.8.10 (S456 round 3) — control for the closed program-body allow-list: a spelled `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`, `PRAGMA table_info`, one `ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN`, an fts5 table with closed options, a partial `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX`, `BEGIN` / `COMMIT` and an INSERT all compile — the shapes flogence/src uses.
rationale: §14.8.10 item (1) (rulings user-voice-scrml.md S456 "a, fix F7/F9 too" + "your recs, go"): each of these statements is on the admitted list, and none gives a relation a `tenant_id` column.
